name: Kennedy Space Center
tagline: Real rockets and a space shuttle — Florida’s tourist STEM day done right.

practical.ticket_note: Hot outdoor queues — water, hats, stroller.
practical.transit_note: Merritt Island; car required for most families.

items.label: Space Shuttle Atlantis
items.one_liner: Stand under a real orbiter — pure wow.

qa_card.question: Where did the shuttle go?
qa_card.answer: To space — and back to Earth on a runway!

do_not_list.name: Dinosaur hall
do_not_list.reason: KSC is spaceflight; no dinosaur hall.

bonus_hunt.tagline: KSC bonus · Rocket Garden + Atlantis energy

challenges.text: Shuttle/orbiter: walk the full length once — nose or engines first memory?
Rocket Garden: tallest rocket from where you stand — point
Saturn V / big rocket hall if open: count engines or nozzles you can see
Hands-on: one switch, lever, or sim you actually tried
Look at the real Florida sky — launch weather yes/no vibe today?

bonus_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find a countdown clock or mission patch wall — pick a favorite patch
bonus_hunt.easter_egg_little: ★ Easter egg: 10…9…8 blast-off crouch jump once (safe open space)
